weapons.name: Ion Dart
weapons.desc: A quick sting that also stuns the crew in the room.

weapons.name: Ion Repeater
weapons.desc: Two ion pulses: strips two shield layers or locks a system for longer.

weapons.name: Ion Lance
weapons.desc: One huge pulse that drains three shield layers at once.

weapons.name: Static Bomb
weapons.desc: Teleports past shields and fills a room with static.

augments.name: Ion Grounding Mesh
augments.desc: 35% chance to shrug off ion damage.

events.text: A derelict weapons barge drifts at the edge of an ion squall, its hold still sealed. The storm crackles closer every minute.

choices.text: Dash in and cut the hold open.

success.text: You grab a crate of ion weaponry and pull away as the storm hits.

fail.text: The storm catches you first. Systems flicker and a console bursts into flames.

choices.text: Ride the storm front with your shields up.

effect.text: Your shields drink the static. The barge's hold yields a crate of ion darts and a grounding mesh.
Some salvage is not worth the hull.
